This '''terrorist group''' was active in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. They were [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]] with [[Anti-Humanism|anti-Human ideology]], and intended to take revenge on the crimes performed by tycoon [[Hugo Bartyn]], who had settled Lamaredd five centuries before that moment.

In 29 BBY, the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sent agents to Lamaredd to investigate the origin of the settlement. They discovered, among other things, this terrorist group.
